items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I got the partnership in Chicago during the time we were with Benny Goodman at the Congress Hotel in the year of 1927

ctx.x: I can't sing from "A Song is Born," there ain't no song. I just dances only and Buck played the piano. Benny Goodman and all the rest of the musicians played on the instruments, had a jam session with it.
Who else was in that film?
